title: service-messaging(http-outbox): the `assertHttpRedeliverable` doc comment still names the redeliver door's old caller requirement; name the `sys_webhook` edit check (follow-up to #27474)
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk

Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task.** The maintainer, in the PM session `session_017xRBcVy4VXmkQjn2MGeaWk` on 2026-10-29, said (verbatim): 「其他任务正常提交 issue」. This card is a non-security follow-up to PR #27474 (merged), filed as a normal card.

Business reason: a doc comment that names the wrong permission for a door misleads the next person who reads it to decide what that door allows. After #27474 the webhook redeliver door admits only a caller with edit access to `sys_webhook`; the comment above the redeliver refusal still says otherwise.
Reader: the dev who takes this card from the queue (a comment-only edit in `packages/services/service-messaging`).
Dedupe: searched the open and closed issues (GitHub issue search scoped to `objectstack-ai/objectstack`) for "http-outbox redeliver comment any authenticated user sys_webhook edit permission" (4 hits) and "webhooks redeliver docstring stale permission http-outbox service-messaging" (10 hits). None covers this comment; the nearest, #27607 (open), is a different stale sentence on the `sys_webhook` object.

## What to change

Note: the file is `packages/services/service-messaging/src/http-outbox.ts`, not under `plugin-webhooks`.

At `origin/main` `a75ddba1`, `packages/services/service-messaging/src/http-outbox.ts:490–491`, in the doc comment of `assertHttpRedeliverable`, section "Why this is a security refusal and not a tidiness one", the sentence reads:

> `POST /api/v1/webhooks/redeliver` is reachable by any authenticated user.

The current check is in `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/redeliver-entitlement.ts:4–17`: the door admits a caller with an object-level `update` admission on `sys_webhook` (`REDELIVER_ADMINISTERED_OBJECT` at `:93`, `REDELIVER_REQUIRED_OPERATION` at `:96`), asked through the security service before the body is read.

The ask: rewrite that sentence (and the clause after it that refers to "that user") so it names the current requirement, edit access to `sys_webhook` as decided by `redeliver-entitlement.ts`, and links that file. The refusal's own reason (a parked row carries no signature) is unchanged and stays.

The same clause appears once more, in the header comment of `packages/services/service-messaging/src/http-outbox-parked-record.integration.test.ts:13–14` ("which any authenticated user can reach"). Correct it in the same edit.

Out of scope: any code or test-assertion change. This is comment-only.
